forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1MNYFW81216M57PS9NDZKBE
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: 'run subcommand: one turn in process over InMemoryTransport.pair()'
+---
+## What
+
+cli-plan.md §4 and §5.4. This is the product CLI: one prompt in, one
+turn, exit.
+
+**The one architecture rule: the CLI reaches the agent through an ACP
+connection.** It must never call `RoutedACPAgent` directly. Only the
+transport changes between the modes. Break this rule and the later
+socket mode becomes a rewrite, and the CLI stops proving the protocol.
+
+In `Sources/acp-agent/RunCommand.swift`:
+
+1. Build the agent with the shared `AgentComposition` of the `acp` task.
+2. `InMemoryTransport.pair()` gives two transports. Bind an
+   `AgentSideConnection` on one, and a `ClientSideConnection` on the
+   other, in one process and with no subprocess. This is the method the
+   Mac app uses (`plan.md` §19).
+3. Drive the turn from the client side: `initialize`, `session/new` with
+   the `cwd`, `session/prompt`, then consume the notifications until a
+   stop reason arrives.
+
+Options in this task: `--cwd <path>` and `--resume <session-id>`.
+`--cwd` selects **which** dotfolder stack the loader reads, so apply it
+before the configuration load, and send the same directory in
+`session/new` (§5.10). `--cwd` together with `--resume` is a usage
+error: the stored session already has a working directory, and it wins.
+
+`--verbose`, `--quiet`, the stdout rules and the exit codes are separate
+tasks. Print the answer plainly here.
+
+- [ ] Pair the two connections in process
+- [ ] Drive initialize, session/new and session/prompt
+- [ ] `--cwd` before the configuration load, and in `session/new`
+- [ ] `--resume` through `session/load`
+- [ ] `--cwd` with `--resume` is a usage error
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `swift run acp-agent run "hello"` runs one turn and prints the
+      answer.
+- [ ] No file in `Sources/acp-agent/` names `RoutedACPAgent` outside
+      `AgentComposition.swift`. The CLI talks to a connection.
+- [ ] `--cwd` with `--resume` exits 2 with a message on stderr.
+- [ ] `--cwd` changes which `config.yaml` the process loads.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/RunCommandTests.swift`: with
+      the scripted model of the shared test support, a `run` turn over
+      the in-process pair gives the scripted answer.
+- [ ] `--cwd` with `--resume` is a usage error, exit 2.
+- [ ] An integration test builds two temporary directories with
+      different `config.yaml` files, and asserts that `--cwd` selects
+      the matching resolved configuration.
+- [ ] A source-level test asserts that no file in `Sources/acp-agent/`
+      other than `AgentComposition.swift` holds the string
+      `RoutedACPAgent`. It pins the architecture rule.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
